Open Juso road-name address search at https://www.juso.go.kr/. Search for `서울특별시 중구 세종대로 110`. From the result list, select the first result whose road-name address contains `서울특별시` and "중구", `세종대로`, and building number `110`. Copy the displayed postal code, road-name address, and lot-number/jibun address if it is shown. Write these values into a spreadsheet with columns Search Query, Postal Code, Road Address, and Jibun Address. In the spreadsheet, calculate `Zip Prefix` with `=LEFT(B2,2)`, calculate `Road Keyword` with the fixed value `세종대로`, and calculate `Address Check` with `=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("서울특별시",C2)),ISNUMBER(SEARCH("세종대로",C2)),ISNUMBER(SEARCH("110",C2))),"MATCH","CHECK")`. Save the final summary in Word to `juso_address_001.docx` with these lines in order: Scenario: 서울시청 address lookup | Search Query: 서울특별시 중구 세종대로 110 | Postal Code: <copy postal code from Juso> | Road Address: <copy road-name address from Juso> | Jibun Address: <copy jibun address from Juso, or write Not shown if absent> | Zip Prefix: <spreadsheet result> | Road Keyword: 세종대로 | Address Check: <spreadsheet result>. Format in Word: line 1 title bold 18pt (no underline); body 11pt regular.
